name: a line of exactly 80 code points stays
format:
const total = aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa + bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb;
total

expect.formatted:
const total = aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa + bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb;
total

name: a line of 81 code points breaks
format:
const total = aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa + bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb;
total

name: a list that does not fit breaks one element a line
format: ["element number 0", "element number 1", "element number 2", "element number 3", "element number 4", "element number 5"]

expect.formatted:
[
  "element number 0",
  "element number 1",
  "element number 2",
  "element number 3",
  "element number 4",
  "element number 5",
]

name: a list that fits stays on one line
a map that does not fit
format: {name: "a long enough name", version: "1.2.3", description: "something much longer"}

name: nested maps break from the outside
format: {server: {host: "localhost", port: 8080}, client: {retries: 3, timeout: 30, verbose: true}}

name: arguments that do not fit
format: someFunction(firstArgument, secondArgument, thirdArgument, fourthArgument, fifth)

expect.formatted:
someFunction(

name: a binary run breaks after each operator
format:
const ok = input.event != null && input.event.pull_request != null && input.event.pull_request.head.sha != "";
ok

name: a run that fits after the equals sign
format:
const result = firstValueInTheSum + secondValueInTheSum + thirdValueInTheSum;
result

expect.formatted:
const result = firstValueInTheSum + secondValueInTheSum + thirdValueInTheSum;
result

name: a run as an argument is indented
format: f(firstValueInTheSum + secondValueInTheSum + thirdValueInTheSum + fourthValueInTheSum)

expect.formatted:
f(
  firstValueInTheSum +
    secondValueInTheSum +
    thirdValueInTheSum +
    fourthValueInTheSum,
)

name: a run of mixed levels
format:
const v = alphaBravoCharlie * deltaEchoFoxtrot + golfHotelIndia * julietKiloLima - mike;
v

name: an and inside an or breaks at the or
format:
const ok = (alphaBravoCharlie && deltaEchoFoxtrot) || (golfHotelIndia && julietKilo);
ok

name: a conditional that does not fit
format:
const label = count > 1000000 ? "more than a million items" : "fewer than a million items";
label

name: a nested conditional that does not fit
format:
const size = n > 1000 ? "a large number of things" : n > 100 ? "a medium number" : "a small number";
size

name: an if that does not fit
format:
const verdict = if (!failed) { "pass" } else if (rate < 0.1) { "flaky" } else { "fail" };
verdict

name: an if test that does not fit
format: if (input.event.pull_request.head.sha != "" && input.event.pull_request.number > 0) { 1 } else { 2 }

name: an if with a block branch breaks
format: if (c) { const a = 1; a } else { 0 }

name: a match that does not fit
format: match kind { "alpha" | "beta" => "first group", "gamma" => "second group", _ => "the rest" }

name: a match arm with a long result
format: match kind { "a" => firstValueInTheSum + secondValueInTheSum + thirdValueInTheSum + fourthValue, _ => 0 }

name: a try that does not fit
format:
const v = try { someFunction(firstArgument, second) } catch (err) { err.message };
v

name: a lambda body breaks after the arrow
format:
const f = (first, second) => first.someLongMethodName(second) + second.otherLongName(first);
f(1, 2)

name: a map entry breaks after its colon
format: {veryLongKeyNumberOne: someFunctionCall(argumentOne) + anotherFunctionCall(argumentTwo), b: 1}

name: a pattern that does not fit
format:
const {alphaBetaGamma, deltaEpsilonZeta, etaThetaIota, kappaLambdaMu, nuXiOmicron} = input;
alphaBetaGamma

name: parameters that do not fit
format:
const f = (alphaBetaGamma, deltaEpsilonZeta, etaThetaIota, kappaLambdaMu, nu) => 1;
f(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)

format:

s

expect.formatted:

s

name: an as test after the equals sign
format:
const order = input.someVeryLongFieldName.anotherLongFieldName as {id: string, qty: int};
order

format: { const a = { const b = { const c = 1; c }; b }; a }
